item.title: Pectra’s May 7 Date Tests Ethereum’s Operator Model
item.description: Ethereum’s Pectra upgrade is set for May 7 after Hoodi’s clean test, but its validator gains still raise a harder question: who can run the node?

item.title: Senate Passes DeFi Rule Repeal, Leaving Tax Reporting Unsettled
item.description: The 70-28 Senate vote blocks an IRS plan to make DeFi front ends report customer sales, but it does not erase taxpayer duty to report crypto gains.
